series.name: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)
series.notes: Residential all-in-one ESS. The inverter is the hybrid core; fault and alarm codes live in manual chapter 8 (8.1 Alarm code = W00-W25, 8.2 Error code = F00-F20/F32) and solutions in chapter 9. F-codes are hard faults that block the inverter; W-codes are warnings. W14-W25 are BMS codes coming from the BluE-PACK battery, not the inverter, and the manual only says 'contact the distributor' for them. Codes below are from manual version 202203 Ver:3.0; a later ESS manual (E3.68KS-D22 / E5KS-D22 / E6KS-D22) renumbers several of these - see CONFLICTS.

title.ur: Soft start time out ho gaya (F00)

meaning.en: Soft-start did not finish within the allowed window, so the inverter stayed off.
meaning.ur: Soft start apne time ke andar complete nahi hua, is liye inverter on nahi hua.

causes.en: DC bus or control supply did not come up in time after switching on.
causes.ur: On karne ke baad DC bus ya control supply time par nahi aayi.

causes.en: Battery or PV input was not connected when the soft-start was attempted.
causes.ur: Soft start ke waqt battery ya PV input connected nahi tha.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off, wait 5 minutes, then restart it and watch the LCD.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir on karke LCD dekh lein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery and PV connectors are fully seated at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery aur PV connectors dono taraf se puri tarah band hain.

notes.en: Manual solution is only 'restart the inverter and wait until it functions normally'.
notes.ur: Manual ka hal hi 'restart the inverter and wait until it functions normally' hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: INV Volt Short - inverter output shorted (F01)
title.ur: INV Volt Short - inverter output short (F01)

meaning.en: The inverter output is short circuited. The manual tells you to drop the load first, because a shorted load looks identical to a shorted inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter output short circuit hai. Load pehle disconnect karein, kyun ke short wala load aur short wala inverter dono aise hi lagte hain.

causes.en: A connected load has a shorted winding or a failed power supply inside.
causes.ur: Load ka koi winding ya andar ka power supply short ho gaya.

causes.en: Output cable crushed, pinched or damaged at a junction.
causes.ur: Output cable kahin pinch, dab ya junction par kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, shut down the inverter and the battery packs.
solutions.ur: Saari power sources disconnect karein, inverter aur battery packs band karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load, then power on and restart the inverter and battery packs.
solutions.ur: Load disconnect karein, phir inverter aur battery packs on karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the code is gone the load was shorted - test each load branch with a multimeter on continuity.
solutions.ur: Agar code chala gaya to load short tha - har load branch ko multimeter se continuity par test karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The residual-current sensor inside the inverter has failed. This is a hardware fault, not a real earth leakage.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka residual current sensor kharab hai. Yeh asli earth leakage nahi, sensor ka hardware fault hai.

causes.en: The GFCI / leakage current sensing circuit has failed.
causes.ur: GFCI ya leakage current sensing circuit kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Water ingress or corrosion around the sensing board after outdoor installation.
causes.ur: Outdoor install ke baad sensing board ke aas paas paani ya zang.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources first.
solutions.ur: Pehle saari power sources disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: If it returns immediately the GFCI board needs replacement by the distributor.
notes.ur: Agar foran wapas aa jaye to GFCI board distributor se badalwana hoga.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage dropped below the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage allowed value se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Input mode is set wrong in the menu, so the inverter expects a source it is not getting.
causes.ur: Menu mein input mode galat set hai, is liye inverter ko aik aisa source mil raha hai jo nahi hai.

causes.en: Battery is deeply discharged, so the bus cannot be charged up.
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ho chuki hai, bus charge nahi ho pa raha.

solutions.en: Check the settings of the input mode and correct them.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage rose above the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage allowed value se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Input mode setting is wrong, so the bus is charged from the wrong source.
causes.ur: Input mode setting galat hai, bus galat source se charge ho raha hai.

causes.en: Battery pack over-voltage or a failed charge circuit pushing the bus up.
causes.ur: Battery pack over-voltage ya charge circuit kharab hone se bus upar gaya.

solutions.en: Check the settings of the input mode and correct them.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery pack DC voltage with a multimeter; it should sit near 51-53 V, not above 57.5 V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery pack DC voltage check karein; yeh 51-53 V ke qareeb hona chahiye, 57.5 V se upar nahi.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is shorted. Almost always a damaged power stage.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus short ho gaya hai. Aam tor par power stage kharab hota hai.

causes.en: IGBT or MOSFET in the inverter shorted, often after a surge or a fan failure.
causes.ur: Inverter ka IGBT ya MOSFET short ho gaya, aksar surge ya fan failure ke baad.

causes.en: Internal DC bus capacitor failed short.
causes.ur: Internal DC bus capacitor short ho gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off and leave it off for at least 5 minutes to discharge the bus.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur bus discharge hone ke liye kam az kam 5 minute band rakhein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: If F06 comes back after every restart the power board is damaged and needs distributor service.
notes.ur: Agar har restart ke baad F06 wapas aaye to power board kharab hai aur distributor se service chahiye.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: PV ISO Under Fault - PV insulation low (F07)
title.ur: PV ISO Under Fault - PV insulation kam (F07)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance of the PV array is too low, so the inverter refuses to connect to grid.
meaning.ur: PV array ka insulation resistance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi ho raha.

causes.en: A PV string or panel has a damp, cracked or contaminated back sheet leaking to frame/ground.
causes.ur: PV string ya panel ki back sheet geeli, phuti ya gandi ho ke frame/ground par leak ho raha hai.

causes.en: A MC4 connector is not fully clicked, or its cable is stripped and touching the frame.
causes.ur: MC4 connector puri tarah click nahi hua, ya uska cable utar ke frame ko chhu raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the ground connection of the PV array and frame.
solutions.ur: PV array aur frame ka ground connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the earth resistance of PV+ and PV- with a megohmmeter: below 2 MOhm means a real ground fault.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se PV+ aur PV- ki earth resistance check karein: 2 MOhm se neeche aik asli ground fault hai.

solutions.en: Isolate strings one at a time to find the leaking string, then inspect that string's connectors.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek-ek karke isolate karein taake leaking string mil jaye, phir us ke connectors dekhein.

notes.en: The manual tells you to contact customer service if resistance is above 2 MOhm but the code stays.
notes.ur: Manual kehta hai ke agar resistance 2 MOhm se upar ho aur phir bhi code aaye to customer service se rabta karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Short circuit seen on the PV input side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke PV input side par short circuit hai.

causes.en: Input mode is set to parallel while one PV input is idle, confusing the detection.
causes.ur: Input mode parallel par set hai jabke aik PV input idle hai, is liye detection confuse ho raha hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted, or MC4 leads touching each other.
causes.ur: PV string short hai, ya MC4 leads aapas mein chhu rahi hain.

solutions.en: Check the input mode setting is correct.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke input mode setting theek hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input, restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein, inverter restart karke theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The bypass relay inside the inverter has failed to switch.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka bypass relay switch nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Bypass relay coil, driver or its contacts have failed.
causes.ur: Bypass relay ki coil, driver ya contacts kharab hain.

causes.en: Relay has stuck welded because of a shock during grid switching.
causes.ur: Grid switching ke waqt shock ki wajah se relay weld ho ke atak gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: The manual only says 'contact customer service' for this one - the relay is not user serviceable.
notes.ur: Manual sirf kehta hai 'customer service se rabta karein' - relay user level par repair nahi hota.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: INV Curr Over - inverter output overcurrent (F10)
title.ur: INV Curr Over - inverter output current zyada (F10)

meaning.en: Inverter output current exceeded the threshold. Usually the backup load is too big.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output current threshold se zyada ho gaya. Aam tor par backup load bohat bada hai.

causes.en: EPS / backup load exceeds the rated output power of the inverter.
causes.ur: EPS ya backup load inverter ki rated output power se zyada hai.

causes.en: A load is inrush-cycling (for example a fridge or AC compressor) on battery.
causes.ur: Battery pe chalte waqt koi load inrush cycle kar raha hai, jaise fridge ya AC compressor.

solutions.en: Wait five minutes for the inverter to restart automatically.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke khud restart hone ke liye paanch minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the EPS loads; if the load exceeds rated output, disconnect some load.
solutions.ur: EPS load check karein; agar load rated output se zyada hai to kuch load disconnect karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: INV DC Over - inverter DC component overcurrent (F11)
title.ur: INV DC Over - inverter DC component zyada current (F11)

meaning.en: The DC-side current inside the inverter is too high.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar DC side current bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Inverter DC-DC stage or its current sensing has drifted.
causes.ur: Inverter ka DC-DC stage ya uska current sensing bigad gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery or PV input transient at power-on.
causes.ur: Power on hote waqt battery ya PV input ka transient.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage with a multimeter in daylight and check it against the inverter's MPPT start voltage before blaming the unit.
solutions.ur: Dopahar mein multimeter se PV ka open circuit voltage check karke inverter ke MPPT start voltage se compare karein, unit par blame lagane se pehle.

notes.en: Manual gives only 'restart and contact customer service'. This is a distributor-level fault.
notes.ur: Manual sirf 'restart karke customer service se rabta karein' kehta hai. Yeh distributor level ka fault hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Ambient temperature around the inverter is too high.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Inverter installed in direct sun or inside a closed, unventilated enclosure.
causes.ur: Inverter seedhi dhoop mein ya band, hawa na chalne wali box mein laga hai.

causes.en: Airflow blocked or a neighbouring heat source too close.
causes.ur: Airflow band hai ya koi doosra heat source bahut qareeb hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter, let it cool for a few minutes, then restart it.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein, kuch minute thanda hone dein, phir dobara restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit; keep the unit shaded and clear of all obstructions.
solutions.ur: Unit ke paas ambient temperature check karein; unit ko shade mein aur har cheez se saaf rakhein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: Sink Over Temp - heatsink over temperature (F13)
title.ur: Sink Over Temp - heatsink temperature zyada (F13)

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink is too hot. The fan or the heatsink path is not doing its job.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka heatsink bohat garam hai. Ya to fan kharab hai ya heatsink ka rasta band hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan failed or is blocked by dust and insects.
causes.ur: Cooling fan kharab hai ya dhool aur keedon se block hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the specified -25 C to 60 C range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature specified -25 C se 60 C range se upar hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then clean the heatsink and fan with a soft brush and clear dust from the vents.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, phir heatsink aur fan ko soft brush se saaf karein aur vents se dhool nikaalein.

solutions.en: Confirm the fan spins freely by hand after cleaning.
solutions.ur: Saaf karne ke baad haath se check karein ke fan aazad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm ambient temperature is inside -25 C to 60 C.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur confirm karein ke ambient temperature -25 C se 60 C ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The relay that connects the inverter to the grid failed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko grid se jorne wala relay kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid relay coil or contact failed, often after a grid outage or surge.
causes.ur: Grid relay ki coil ya contact kharab, aksar grid outage ya surge ke baad.

causes.en: Supply voltage to the relay driver out of range.
causes.ur: Relay driver ko milne wali supply voltage range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input, restart the inverter and check whether the fault still exists.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein, inverter restart karke dekhein ke fault ab bhi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the grid-side relay wiring and tighten the AC output terminals.
solutions.ur: Grid side relay wiring check karein aur AC output terminals kass lein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: DisChg Curr Over - discharge current zyada (F15)

meaning.en: Battery is being discharged with too much current.
meaning.ur: Battery bohat zyada current se discharge ho rahi hai.

causes.en: EPS load exceeds the rated output power of the inverter.
causes.ur: EPS load inverter ki rated output power se zyada hai.

causes.en: Battery pack internal resistance high or cells shorted, pulling excess current.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka internal resistance zyada hai ya cells short hain, zyada current kheench rahe hain.

solutions.en: Wait one minute for the inverter to restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke restart hone ke liye aik minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the load is in compliance with the specification and shed excess load.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke load specification ke mutabiq hai ya nahi aur extra load hata dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery pack's terminal voltage; any pack much lower than the others is suspect.
solutions.ur: Har battery pack ka terminal voltage check karein; jo pack doosron se kaafi neeche ho wohi kharab hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: Chg Curr Over - charge current zyada (F16)

meaning.en: Battery charging current exceeded the limit.
meaning.ur: Battery ka charging current limit se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery wiring port is short circuited.
causes.ur: Battery wiring port short circuit hai.

causes.en: Charging current is set in the menu above the battery's rating.
causes.ur: Menu mein charging current battery ki rating se zyada set hai.

solutions.en: Check if the battery wiring port is short circuited; inspect the connector and cable for exposed copper.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery wiring port short circuit to nahi; connector aur cable mein khula copper dekhein.

solutions.en: Check if charging current is in compliance with the presetting and lower it to the pack rating.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke charging current presetting ke mutabiq hai ya nahi aur use pack rating par kam karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: A current sensor inside the inverter has failed, so the inverter cannot trust its own current reading.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka koi current sensor kharab hai, is liye inverter apna current reading sahi nahi samajhta.

causes.en: Current sensing circuit or its hall sensor has failed.
causes.ur: Current sensing circuit ya uska hall sensor kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Sensing wiring harness loose or corroded at the connector.
causes.ur: Sensing wiring harness ka connector dheela ya zang lage hue hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery disconnected, check the current-sensor harness connector is fully seated and free of corrosion.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery disconnect kar ke check karein ke current sensor harness ka connector puri tarah laga hua hai aur us par zang nahi hai.

notes.en: Immediate return of F17 means a failed sensor board - distributor replacement only.
notes.ur: Agar F17 foran wapas aaye to matlab sensor board kharab hai - sirf distributor badal sakta hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Inverter output voltage or frequency is abnormal. The manual sends this straight to the distributor.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage ya frequency abnormal hai. Manual isay seedha distributor ko bhejta hai.

causes.en: Inverter output stage or its sensing has drifted out of tolerance.
causes.ur: Inverter output stage ya uska sensing tolerance se bahar chala gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage or frequency outside the accepted window at the time of the fault.
causes.ur: Fault ke waqt grid voltage ya frequency accepted window se bahar tha.

solutions.en: Measure the grid voltage and frequency with a multimeter before touching the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit chhune se pehle multimeter se grid voltage aur frequency check karein.

solutions.en: Turn off the EPS output switches and restart the inverter to see if the code clears.
solutions.ur: EPS output switches band karein aur inverter restart karke dekhein ke code chala ya nahi.

notes.en: Manual solution is literally '(1) Please contact the distributor.'
notes.ur: Manual ka hal bilkul yehi hai: distributor se rabta karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The EPS (emergency power supply / backup) relay failed to switch the load over.
meaning.ur: EPS relay load ko transfer karne mein nakaam raha.

causes.en: EPS relay coil, driver or contacts failed.
causes.ur: EPS relay ki coil, driver ya contacts kharab hain.

causes.en: EPS load side short or overload that welded the relay closed.
causes.ur: EPS load side par short ya overload jis ne relay ko weld kar diya.

solutions.en: Turn off all the switches on the EPS load end, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: EPS load end ke tamam switches band karein, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the load one item at a time to find the item that trips the relay.
solutions.ur: Load ko aik aik karke wapas lagayein taake pata chale ke kaun sa item relay trip kar raha hai.

notes.en: Manual: 'If the code is still shown, contact Customer Service.'
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq: agar code phir bhi aa raha ho to Customer Service se rabta karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The EPS load permanently exceeds the rated output power of the system, so the inverter keeps stopping.
meaning.ur: EPS load hamesha system ki rated output power se zyada hai, is liye inverter baar baar ruk raha hai.

causes.en: Connected backup load is larger than the inverter's continuous rating.
causes.ur: Lagaya hua backup load inverter ki continuous rating se bada hai.

causes.en: Load was increased after installation without resizing the inverter.
causes.ur: Install ke baad load barha diya gaya bina inverter resize kiye.

solutions.en: Switch off the EPS load, measure the total connected watts, and compare to the inverter's rated output.
solutions.ur: EPS load band karein, kul connected watts naappein, aur inverter ki rated output se compare karein.

solutions.en: Remove or reschedule the largest loads (AC, geyser, pump) so the inverter runs below 80 percent.
solutions.ur: Bade loads (AC, geyser, pump) hata dein ya shift karein taake inverter 80 percent se neeche chale.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Internal communication between the inverter's two controllers has failed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke do controllers ke darmiyan internal communication nahi chal rahi.

causes.en: Internal control board to control board communication link failed.
causes.ur: Internal control board se control board ka link kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Erratic supply to the control boards after a mains failure.
causes.ur: Mains failure ke baad control boards ko erratic supply mila.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter fully, wait 5 minutes, then power it back on.
solutions.ur: Inverter poori tarah band karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Check the communication cable between inverter and battery pack is seated and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter aur battery pack ke darmiyan communication cable puri tarah lagi hui hai aur kharab nahi.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Incoming grid voltage is low. The inverter keeps working but warns the user.
meaning.ur: Aane wala grid voltage kam hai. Inverter chal raha hai magar warning de raha hai.

causes.en: Area supply voltage is low, common on long feeder lines in local load shedding.
causes.ur: Area ka supply voltage kam hai, lambi feeder line par aam baat hai.

causes.en: Heavy load on the same line pulling the voltage down.
causes.ur: Usi line par bohat load lag raha hai aur voltage gir gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency with a multimeter and compare to the inverter spec.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se grid voltage aur frequency check karke inverter spec se compare karein.

solutions.en: If within range, wait two minutes; if the grid is genuinely out of range, report it to the utility.
solutions.ur: Agar range mein hai to do minute intezaar karein; agar grid asal mein range se bahar hai to power company ko report karein.

notes.en: This is one of the most common Kstar complaints in Pakistan - low incoming voltage.
notes.ur: Yeh Pakistan mein Kstar ki sab se aam shikayat hai - aane wala voltage kam hona.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Incoming grid voltage is above the accepted window.
meaning.ur: Aane wala grid voltage allowed window se upar hai.

causes.en: Utility supply voltage high, often at the end of a lightly loaded feeder.
causes.ur: Power company ka voltage high hai, aksar kam load wali feeder ke aakhir par.

causes.en: Stabiliser or transformer in the supply chain is set to boost.
causes.ur: Supply chain mein stabiliser ya transformer boost par set hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter and check it against the inverter's accepted grid window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se grid voltage check karein aur inverter ke grid window se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check any stabiliser or transformer in the path and set it to the correct tap.
solutions.ur: Raste mein koi bhi stabiliser ya transformer check karke usay theek tap par set karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below normal. Typical during generator changeover.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency normal se kam hai. Generator changeover ke waqt aam baat hai.

causes.en: Utility frequency dip, or the site is running on a generator that is not at speed.
causes.ur: Power company ka frequency gir gaya, ya site generator par hai jo speed par nahi.

causes.en: Generator governor is not holding 50 Hz.
causes.ur: Generator ka governor 50 Hz par hold nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Check grid frequency with a multimeter; it should be 50 Hz or 60 Hz depending on local supply.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se grid frequency check karein; yeh local supply ke mutabiq 50 Hz ya 60 Hz hona chahiye.

solutions.en: On a generator site, adjust the generator governor until frequency is back in range.
solutions.ur: Generator site par governor adjust karein jab tak frequency range mein na aa jaye.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Grid frequency is above normal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency normal se zyada hai.

causes.en: Generator running fast with a light load.
causes.ur: Kam load par generator tez chal raha hai.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion.
causes.ur: Power company ka frequency hat gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure frequency with a multimeter and wait two minutes for it to settle.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se frequency check karein aur do minute settle hone dein.

solutions.en: Reduce generator load or adjust the governor before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Generator ka load kam karein ya governor theek karein, phir inverter restart karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: No PV panels producing, or PV input voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Ya to koi PV panel produce nahi kar raha, ya PV input voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: PV is not connected at all.
causes.ur: PV bilkul connected nahi hai.

causes.en: Heavy cloud, dust or night-time, so panel voltage sits below the start threshold.
causes.ur: Bhaari baadal, dhool ya raat ka waqt, jis se panel voltage start threshold se neeche gir jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV connection and the MC4 plugs at both the panel and the inverter.
solutions.ur: PV connection aur MC4 plugs panel aur inverter dono taraf check karein.

solutions.en: Measure open-circuit PV voltage with a multimeter in daylight; compare it with the inverter MPPT start voltage.
solutions.ur: Dopahar mein multimeter se PV ka open circuit voltage check karein; usay inverter ke MPPT start voltage se compare karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: Battery connect nahi ya voltage kam (W05)

meaning.en: No battery pack is connected, or the battery voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Ya to koi battery pack connected nahi, ya battery voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Battery pack not connected, or the BMS to inverter cable is loose.
causes.ur: Battery pack connected nahi, ya BMS se inverter ka cable dheela hai.

causes.en: Battery pack deeply discharged below the inverter's minimum input voltage.
causes.ur: Battery pack inverter ki minimum input voltage se neeche gehri tarah discharge ho gayi.

solutions.en: Check if the battery wiring port is short circuited and reseat all battery connectors firmly.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery wiring port short circuit to nahi, aur saare battery connectors mazbooti se lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage with a multimeter; a healthy BluE-PACK pack reads about 51-53 V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery DC voltage check karein; theek BluE-PACK 51-53 V par hota hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Under-voltage has occurred in the battery.
meaning.ur: Battery mein under-voltage aa gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery discharged too deep during a long power cut.
causes.ur: Lambi power cut mein battery bohat gehri tarah discharge ho gayi.

causes.en: Charge current set too low, so the pack cannot recover in time.
causes.ur: Charge current bohat kam set hai, is liye pack waqt par charge nahi hota.

solutions.en: Check the battery packs for their availability and physical condition.
solutions.ur: Battery packs ki availability aur physical condition check karein.

solutions.en: If battery voltage is below the inverter minimum, charge the battery until it reaches the accepted input voltage.
solutions.ur: Agar battery voltage inverter minimum se neeche hai to battery ko charge karein jab tak accepted input voltage na aa jaye.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Battery voltage is low, so backup time is being reduced.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage kam hai, is liye backup time kam ho raha hai.

causes.en: Battery not fully charged, or grid is not available long enough to charge it.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah charge nahi, ya charging ke liye grid itni der nahi chala.

causes.en: One battery pack in a parallel set is weak and dragging the string down.
causes.ur: Parallel set mein aik battery pack kamzor hai aur poora string neeche kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure each pack's voltage separately; the weak pack will read clearly lower than the rest.
solutions.ur: Har pack ka voltage alag alag check karein; kamzor pack baqi se saaf neeche padhega.

solutions.en: Give the system 6-8 hours of mains supply and re-measure before assuming a battery fault.
solutions.ur: System ko 6-8 ghante mains dein aur battery fault samajhne se pehle dobara voltage check karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Battery voltage is above the setting and the pack has shut charging to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage setting se upar hai aur pack ne apni hifazat ke liye charging band kar di.

causes.en: Battery chemistry or voltage set-point in the menu does not match the fitted pack.
causes.ur: Menu mein battery chemistry ya voltage set-point lagay huay pack se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is above 45 C, which pushes charge voltage up.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature 45 C se upar hai, jis se charge voltage upar chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Check if the battery is in line with the presetting in the menu.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke menu ki presetting ke mutabiq battery hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it does match, power off and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar match karti hai to power off karke inverter restart karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: Connected load exceeds the rated power of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Lagaya hua load inverter ki rated power se zyada hai.

causes.en: More appliances connected than the inverter was sized for.
causes.ur: Inverter ki capacity se zyada appliances lagaye gaye hain.

causes.en: An appliance drawing large inrush, such as an AC or water pump.
causes.ur: Koi aik appliance bohat bara inrush le raha hai, jaise AC ya water pump.

solutions.en: Wait one minute for the inverter to restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke restart ke liye aik minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the load is in compliance with the specification and unplug the excess.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke load specification ke mutabiq hai ya nahi aur extra load nikaal dein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: High leakage current detected. The manual table prints this row as 'CFCI Over', the code list prints it as 'GFCI Over'.
meaning.ur: Bohat zyada leakage current mila hai. Manual ki table isay 'CFCI Over' likhti hai, code list 'GFCI Over'.

causes.en: PV string has direct or indirect grounding.
causes.ur: PV string mein direct ya indirect grounding ho gayi hai.

causes.en: An appliance on the AC side has a leakage current fault, e.g. a wet heater or filter.
causes.ur: AC side par kisi appliance mein leakage current fault hai, jaise geela heater ya filter.

solutions.en: Check PV string for direct or indirect grounding and correct it.
solutions.ur: PV string par direct ya indirect grounding check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Check the peripherals of the machine for current leakage and rectify anything you find.
solutions.ur: Machine ke aas paas ke devices mein current leakage check karke jo mila use theek karein.

notes.en: Manual spells the meaning 'CFCI Over' in the diagnosis table but 'GFCI Over' in the code list - same code, inconsistent spelling.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein 'CFCI Over' likha hai magar code list mein 'GFCI Over' - aik hi code, spelling alag.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: LN Reverse - line aur neutral ulat (W11)

meaning.en: Live and neutral are connected the wrong way round at the AC input.
meaning.ur: AC input par live aur neutral aik doosre ki jagah lagi hui hain.

causes.en: Installation did not follow the instructions, or a junction was re-wired by a local electrician.
causes.ur: Install instructions ke mutabiq nahi hua, ya kisi junction ko local electrician ne dobara wire kiya.

causes.en: Supply leads swapped when the unit was shifted or re-mounted.
causes.ur: Unit hatane ya dobara lagane par supply leads aik doosre ki jagah ho gaye.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply and the inverter, then confirm L and N with a multimeter or a socket tester.
solutions.ur: AC supply aur inverter band karein, phir multimeter ya socket tester se L aur N confirm karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate the AC input so live goes to L and neutral to N, then earth the chassis properly.
solutions.ur: AC input dobara terminate karein: live L par, neutral N par, aur chassis ko zaroor earth karein.

notes.en: Manual solution: '(1) Check whether the installation follows the instructions; (2) Contact customer service if error warning continues.'
notes.ur: Manual ka hal: '(1) Check whether the installation follows the instructions; (2) Contact customer service if error warning continues.'

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: The inverter cooling fan has malfunctioned. If you ignore it you will get F12 or F13 next.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai. Isay ignore kiya to baad mein F12 ya F13 aa jayega.

causes.en: Fan motor has seized or its brushless bearing has worn out.
causes.ur: Fan motor jam ho gaya ya uska brushless bearing kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Fan cable loose or the fan connector not seated.
causes.ur: Fan ka cable dheela hai ya fan connector puri tarah nahi laga.

solutions.en: Power off, then check that the fan blades spin freely by hand with power disconnected.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, phir power ke baghair fan blades ko haath se aazad ghoomne ka test karein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector is fully seated and the fan cable has no break.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke fan connector puri tarah laga hua hai aur fan cable mein toota hua hissa nahi.

solutions.en: Clear dust from the fan hub and heatsink before reassembling.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagane se pehle fan hub aur heatsink se dhool saaf karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: BAT Power Down - battery shut down on low SOC (W13)
title.ur: BAT Power Down - battery ne low SOC par band ki (W13)

meaning.en: The battery has shut down because its state of charge dropped too low.
meaning.ur: Battery ne apna band kar diya kyunke uska SOC bohat neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Long power outage drained the pack below the DoD limit.
causes.ur: Lambi power outage ne pack ko DoD limit se neeche drain kar diya.

causes.en: DoD set too deep in the menu for the actual pack size.
causes.ur: Menu mein DoD actual pack size ke liye bohat zyada set hai.

solutions.en: Check the SOC on the display and compare it with the set DoD.
solutions.ur: Display par SOC check karke set ki gayi DoD se compare karein.

solutions.en: Restore mains supply and let the pack recharge fully before switching loads back on.
solutions.ur: Mains supply wapas karein aur load on karne se pehle pack ko poori tarah charge hone dein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: BMS ne discharge current zyada bataya (W14)

meaning.en: Battery management system reports a discharge overcurrent from the pack. Codes W14-W25 are all BMS-reported.
meaning.ur: Battery management system pack se discharge overcurrent bata raha hai. Codes W14 se W25 tak sab BMS ke hain.

causes.en: A short circuit or an oversized load on the battery / EPS side.
causes.ur: Battery ya EPS side par short circuit ya bohat bada load.

causes.en: A cell inside the pack has internally shorted.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar koi cell internally short ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the EPS load and the inverter, then measure each pack's terminal voltage.
solutions.ur: EPS load aur inverter band karke har pack ka terminal voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Reseat the BMS communication cable between inverter and pack, then power up again.
solutions.ur: BMS communication cable dobara mazbooti se lagayein, phir power up karein.

notes.en: The manual groups W14-W25 under 'BMS Fault' with the single solution 'Please contact the distributor.' Codes are listed here individually from the 8.1 table, solutions are technician practice.
notes.ur: Manual ka hal bilkul yehi hai: distributor se rabta karein (1).

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: BMS ne charge current zyada bataya (W15)

meaning.en: Battery management system reports a charge overcurrent on the pack.
meaning.ur: Battery management system pack par charge overcurrent bata raha hai.

causes.en: Charge current setting is above the pack's permitted limit.
causes.ur: Charge current setting pack ki ijazat se zyada hai.

causes.en: A cell internally shorted inside the pack, so charging current spikes.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar koi cell internally short hai, is liye charging current spike karta hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the charge current in the menu to the pack's rated 0.5C value.
solutions.ur: Menu mein charge current pack ke rated 0.5C par kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure each pack's terminal voltage; the pack that is hot or low is the faulty one.
solutions.ur: Har pack ka terminal voltage check karein; jo pack garam ya kam voltage wala hai wohi kharab hai.

notes.en: Grouped under 'BMS Fault' in the manual diagnosis table.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein yeh 'BMS Fault' ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: BMS reports pack over-voltage and has stopped charging.
meaning.ur: BMS pack over-voltage bata raha hai aur charging band kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Pack cell imbalance; one cell has drifted high.
causes.ur: Pack ke cells mein imbalance hai; aik cell zyada upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage high, pushing the charge voltage past the pack limit.
causes.ur: Grid voltage high hai, jis se charge voltage pack limit se upar chala gaya.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and the pack's total DC voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se grid voltage aur pack ka kul DC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Run a full charge-and-absorb cycle and re-measure; a cell that stays high is a bad cell.
solutions.ur: Poora charge aur absorb cycle chalayein aur dobara check karein; jo cell hamesha upar rahe woh kharab cell hai.

notes.en: Grouped under 'BMS Fault' in the manual diagnosis table.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein yeh 'BMS Fault' ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: BMS reports the pack is over temperature.
meaning.ur: BMS bata raha hai ke pack temperature se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Pack is in direct sun or inside a poorly ventilated battery room.
causes.ur: Pack seedhi dhoop mein hai ya kam hawa wale battery room mein.

causes.en: Battery room ambient above the operating range of 0 to 50 C for charging.
causes.ur: Battery room ka ambient charging ke liye 0 se 50 C operating range se upar hai.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the pack; move it to shade if above 45 C.
solutions.ur: Pack ke paas ambient temperature check karein; 45 C se upar ho to use shade mein le jayein.

solutions.en: Check the pack fan and vents are clear of dust so the BMS can self-cool.
solutions.ur: Pack ka fan aur vents dhool se saaf hain ya nahi check karein taake BMS khud thanda ho sake.

notes.en: Grouped under 'BMS Fault' in the manual diagnosis table.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein yeh 'BMS Fault' ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: BMS ne discharge temperature kam bataya (W18)

meaning.en: Too cold to discharge the pack; the BMS has blocked discharge.
meaning.ur: Pack itna thanda hai ke discharge nahi ho sakta; BMS ne discharge block kar diya.

causes.en: Pack temperature below the low-temperature discharge limit (BMS cuts out around -18 C on later Kstar models).
causes.ur: Pack temperature low temperature discharge limit se neeche hai (BMS naye Kstar models par aazman -18 C par band karta hai).

causes.en: Pack installed outdoors in a cold wave with no shelter.
causes.ur: Pack kisi shelter ke baghair outdoors cold wave mein lage hue hain.

solutions.en: Read the pack temperature on the inverter inquiry screen.
solutions.ur: Inverter inquiry screen par pack ka temperature parh lein.

solutions.en: Let the pack warm up naturally; do not use a heat gun or open flame on the battery.
solutions.ur: Pack ko khud garam hone dein; battery par heat gun ya shola na lagayein.

notes.en: Grouped under 'BMS Fault' in the manual diagnosis table.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein yeh 'BMS Fault' ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: BMS Volt Imbalance - cell voltage imbalance (W19)
title.ur: BMS Volt Imbalance - cell voltage ghabrat (W19)

meaning.en: Voltage imbalance has occurred among the cells in the battery.
meaning.ur: Battery ke cells ke darmiyan voltage ka ghabrat aa gaya hai.

causes.en: One or more cells have aged differently, so the pack never balances.
causes.ur: Aik ya zyada cells alag umar ke hain, is liye pack balance nahi hota.

causes.en: A cell with high internal resistance, often after deep discharge.
causes.ur: Aik cell jiski internal resistance zyada hai, aksar gehri discharge ke baad.

solutions.en: Run one full charge-and-absorb cycle and read the cell voltages again.
solutions.ur: Aik poora charge aur absorb cycle chalayein aur cell voltages dobara parh lein.

solutions.en: On a serviceable pack, equalise only as the battery manufacturer instructs; otherwise replace the pack.
solutions.ur: Serviceable pack par sirf battery manufacturer ki hidayat ke mutabiq equalise karein; warna pack badal dein.

notes.en: Manual gives only 'Contact Customer Service' for BMS Volt Imbalance.
notes.ur: Manual BMS Volt Imbalance ke liye sirf 'Contact Customer Service' kehta hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: BMS Communicate Fault - pack comms failed (W20)
title.ur: BMS Communicate Fault - pack ka communication fail (W20)

meaning.en: The BMS cannot talk to the inverter, so the inverter has no idea of the pack state.
meaning.ur: BMS inverter se baat nahi kar pa raha, is liye inverter ko pack ki halat ki koi information nahi.

causes.en: CAN/RS-485 communication cable loose, cut or not seated at either end.
causes.ur: CAN/RS-485 communication cable dheeli, kaati ya kisi bhi taraf se nahi lagi.

causes.en: Pack address dialed the same as another pack, so two packs answer on one address.
causes.ur: Pack ka address doosre pack jaisa set hai, is liye do pack aik hi address par jawab de rahe hain.

solutions.en: Make sure the COM cable between the inverter and the battery pack is in good condition and connected correctly.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter aur battery pack ke darmiyan COM cable theek hai aur sahi tarah lagi hui hai.

solutions.en: Check the pack address dial: the first pack is address 1, then 2, 3 and so on, with no duplicates.
solutions.ur: Pack address dial check karein: pehla pack address 1, phir 2, 3 aise, aur koi duplicate na ho.

notes.en: Manual solution is exactly the cable/address check, so this code is fully actionable in the field.
notes.ur: Manual ka hal yehi cable aur address check hai, is liye yeh code field mein poori tarah hal kiya ja sakta hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

meaning.en: BMS reports pack under-voltage. W14-W18 and W21-W24 are all BMS ALARM warnings per the manual.
meaning.ur: BMS pack under-voltage bata raha hai. Manual ke mutabiq W14 se W18 aur W21 se W24 sab BMS ALARM warnings hain.

causes.en: Pack discharged below its lowest acceptable cell voltage.
causes.ur: Pack apni sab se kam qubool cell voltage se neeche discharge ho gaya.

causes.en: Cell imbalance means one cell drops early and drags the pack reading down.
causes.ur: Cell imbalance ki wajah se aik cell jaldi girta hai aur pack reading neeche kheenchta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the pack terminal voltage with a multimeter before recharging.
solutions.ur: Recharge se pehle multimeter se pack ka terminal voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Give the pack a full charge and re-read; if the under-voltage warning persists the pack is at end of life.
solutions.ur: Pack ko poori tarah charge karke dobara parh lein; agar under voltage warning bachi rahe to pack ki umar khatam ho gayi.

notes.en: Manual directs W14-W18 and W21-W24 to 'see BMS ALARM Warnings'; the BMS table is in chapter 9 of a later manual.
notes.ur: Manual W14 se W18 aur W21 se W24 ko 'BMS ALARM Warnings' dekne ko kehta hai; BMS table naye manual ke chapter 9 mein hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: BMS Chg Temp Low - charge temperature too low (W22)
title.ur: BMS Chg Temp Low - charge temperature bohat kam (W22)

meaning.en: The pack is too cold to charge, so the BMS has blocked charging.
meaning.ur: Pack itna thanda hai ke charge nahi ho sakta, BMS ne charging block kar di.

causes.en: Pack temperature below the low charge-temperature threshold (about 2 C on later Kstar BMS).
causes.ur: Pack temperature low charge temperature threshold se neeche hai (naye Kstar BMS par taqreeban 2 C).

causes.en: Charging attempted in very early morning or winter in northern Pakistan.
causes.ur: Bohat subah ya north Pakistan mein sard moausam mein charging ki koshish ki gayi.

solutions.en: Read the pack temperature on the inverter inquiry screen before forcing a charge.
solutions.ur: Charge par majboor karne se pehle inverter inquiry screen par pack temperature parh lein.

solutions.en: Charge in the warmer part of the day; the BMS will release charging on its own once warm.
solutions.ur: Din ke garam hisse mein charge karein; garam hote hi BMS apne aap charging chhor dega.

notes.en: Grouped under 'BMS Fault' in the manual diagnosis table.
notes.ur: Manual diagnosis table mein yeh 'BMS Fault' ke andar hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: BMS ne shiddid over voltage bataya (W23)

meaning.en: BMS reports a severe pack over-voltage, above the normal W16 over-voltage warning.
meaning.ur: BMS pack ke shiddid over-voltage ki report kar raha hai, jo normal W16 warning se upar hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage high while charging, pushing pack voltage past its hard limit.
causes.ur: Charging ke waqt grid voltage high hai, jis se pack voltage hard limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: A cell has failed short or open, so the BMS sees an extreme pack reading.
causes.ur: Aik cell short ya open ho gaya, is liye BMS ko extreme pack reading dikh rahi hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV and stop charging; measure grid voltage and pack DC voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: PV disconnect karke charging band karein; multimeter se grid voltage aur pack DC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Read the pack's BMS fault code from the PACK INFO screen on the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke PACK INFO screen se pack ka BMS fault code parh lein.

notes.en: Listed in the 8.1 alarm code table with no individual solution row; the diagnosis table only says 'contact the distributor'.
notes.ur: 8.1 alarm code table mein likha hai magar iska koi alag hal nahi; diagnosis table sirf kehti hai 'contact the distributor'.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.ur: BMS ne shiddid over temperature bataya (W24)

meaning.en: BMS reports severe pack over-temperature, above the normal W17 over-temperature warning.
meaning.ur: BMS pack ke shiddid over-temperature ki report kar raha hai, jo normal W17 warning se upar hai.

causes.en: Cell temperature has passed the point where the BMS must cut charge and discharge MOS.
causes.ur: Cell temperature us se guzar chuki hai jahan BMS ko charge aur discharge MOS band karne padte hain.

causes.en: Pack cooling fan failed, so temperature climbed unchecked.
causes.ur: Pack ka cooling fan kharab ho gaya, is liye temperature bina check ke chadhti rahi.

solutions.en: Stop the system and let it cool; do not open the pack while it is hot.
solutions.ur: System band karke thanda hone dein; garam haalat mein pack na kholein.

solutions.en: Check the pack fan and cooling vents are running and free of dust.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke pack ka fan aur cooling vents chal rahe hain aur dhool se saaf hain.

notes.en: Listed in the 8.1 alarm code table with no individual solution row.
notes.ur: 8.1 alarm code table mein likha hai magar iska koi alag hal nahi.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

title.en: CT Reverse - current transformer direction wrong (W25)
title.ur: CT Reverse - current transformer ki direction galat (W25)

meaning.en: The current transformer is installed backwards, so export and import read swapped. This is an installation error, not a pack fault.
meaning.ur: Current transformer ulta lagaya gaya hai, is liye export aur import aik doosre ki jagah parh rahe hain. Yeh install ghalti hai, pack ka fault nahi.

causes.en: CT arrow points to the inverter instead of towards the load.
causes.ur: CT ka arrow inverter ki taraf hai, load ki taraf nahi.

causes.en: CT clamped on the wrong conductor (L and N swapped, or on the wrong phase).
causes.ur: CT galat conductor par laga hai (L aur N aik doosre ki jagah, ya galat phase par).

solutions.en: Power down, then unclamp the CT and re-clamp it with the arrow pointing towards the load as the manual requires.
solutions.ur: Power down karein, phir CT kholkar dobara lagein jis ka arrow load ki taraf ho, jaise manual kehta hai.

solutions.en: Check the inverter shows positive power when consuming and negative when feeding the grid.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter consume karte waqt positive aur grid ko power bhejte waqt negative dikhata hai.

notes.en: Note the manual groups W25 with BMS faults in the diagnosis table, but the 8.1 code list clearly defines W25 as 'CT Reverse' - an installation alarm, not a battery fault.
notes.ur: Dhyan dein manual isay diagnosis table mein BMS faults ke saath rakhta hai, magar 8.1 code list saaf likhta hai W25 = 'CT Reverse' - yeh install alarm hai, battery fault nahi.
